Markus —

Thanks for the outline. Quick read-through comments from the OKR lens:

1) Risked OKRs:
- "Reduce inference unit cost 20%" (Ops/Runtime) — the change to routing policy and team ownership may introduce temporary variance in batching strategy. Estimated 2-3 week performance delta unless we schedule a staggered rollout per region.
- "99.9% P95 latency for hosted API" — might see a small bump during transition of Dedicated scheduling logic. Recommend we keep a canary lane and a guarded fallback for 4 weeks.

2) Mitigations:
- Protect the customer-facing latency OKR by gating any routing changes behind a canary that must meet latency SLO for 72 hours before widening.
- Move the cost-optimization initiatives (quantization, batching tuning) to a parallel sprint so they continue irrespective of the reorg.

I'll produce a 1‑page OKR impact memo and proposed mitigations by Thursday morning. If we need to shift a milestone on the timeline (week-of Mar 8), call it out and I'll reprioritize.

—Karthik
Director, Inference Engineering
